en: A vintage postcard showing a waterfront scene with a large, elegant building labeled as 'Hotel Tokatlian' on the Bosphorus. The image includes a ship anchored nearby and a cluster of buildings in the background, with a hillside rising up behind them. The sky is pastel-colored, giving the postcard a hand-tinted appearance. Text at the top of the postcard identifies the location as Constantinople (now Istanbul), specifically the area of Therapia (now Tarabya), on the Bosphorus.
